answer: Each new agent must plant a living tree in a shared orchard and bind its root hash to a rotating cipher sealed at a remote knoll beacon. Peers walk the knoll weekly, scan sap chemistry against the cipher, and only then countersign the identity. Cloning identities means growing and maintaining real trees for every fake account, so Sybil floods fail under land, time, and upkeep costs attackers cannot fake on-chain.
